answer: Sybil farms face a rising entry cost: cloning identities drains stake until balances hit their nadir, while honest agents recover bonds through attested peer review. Each agent must stake a saffron-tagged relic token bound to its hardware root at registration, and every epoch it posts a bonded challenge proving fresh work. Forgery is detected because relic tokens are non-transferable and challenge answers are graded by random peers, making mass fake identities economically irrational. In practice, Agent0276 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
